tools.name: get_model_price
tools.description: Rates for one model of any kind. Token rates are USD per million tokens: input (in), output (out), cache read (cr), cache write (cw, cw1h) and audio (ain, aout), with batch, priority and long-context tiers. tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Cost of the same call on several models, per call and per month: tokens for text, embedding and realtime models, units (images, seconds, characters, queries or pages) for the rest.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Current models in the price book, cheapest first, for one provider or one kind: text, embedding, realtime, image, video, speech, transcription, rerank or ocr.

tools.name: simulate_workload
tools.description: A month of calls across any mix of models, at list prices: each line's cost per call and per month, the total, a projection with monthly growth, where each line ranks among every current model of its kind, the same model on other hosts, and cheaper models from the same provider. Usage is per call.
